source_deduplication_policy: Each exact inspected work/edition has one ID. Publication, deposit and event dates are separated. Related programmes and predecessor works are not counted as independent replications.
evidence_role_policy: Historical provenance, definitions, formal results, guidance, empirical comparisons, field observations, criticism, implementation semantics and researcher interpretation remain separate; no averaged confidence score.
